discoveries.insight: Built 3-tool LOD onboarding: generator, query, session writer. Tree has 55 sequences, 498 maps, 1670 artifacts.

Maps are narrative spaces: entry(spawn+context) → teaching(main artifact) → exploration(related artifacts) → reflection(text+darkness) → exit(teleporter). Artifact params: name:rotation:y_offset. Structure 0=void 1=floor 2+=wall. Utilities: sp/t/ds/r/m:x:y:z:delay/an:angle/sub:scene/3t:text. The Map Studio at /map-studio understands all 3 layers.
